entries.title: Jeremiah 13:1
segments: ¶Thus the LORD said to me: "Go and get yourself a linen sash, and put it around your waist, but do not put it in water."

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:2
segments: So I got a sash according to the word of the LORD, and put [it] around my waist.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:3
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me the second time, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:4
segments: "Take the sash that you acquired, which [is] around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole in the rock."

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:5
segments: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:6
segments: Now it came to pass after many days that the LORD said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the sash which I commanded you to hide there."

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:7
segments: Then I went to the Euphrates and dug, and I took the sash from the place where I had hidden it; and there was the sash, ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:8
segments: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:9
segments: "Thus says the LORD: 'In this manner I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:10
segments: 'This evil people, who refuse to hear My words, who follow the dictates of their hearts, and walk after other gods to serve them and worship them, shall be just like this sash which is profitable for nothing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:11
segments: 'For as the sash clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to Me,' says the LORD, 'that they may become My people, for renown, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:12
segments: ¶"Therefore you shall speak to them this word: 'Thus says the LORD God of Israel: "Every bottle shall be filled with wine."' And they will say to you, 'Do we not certainly know that every bottle will be filled with wine?'

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:13
segments: "Then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the LORD: "Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land-even the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem-with drunkenness!

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:14
segments: "And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together," says the LORD. "I will not pity nor spare nor have mercy, but will destroy them."'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:15
segments: Hear and give ear: Do not be proud, For the LORD has spoken.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:16
segments: Give glory to the LORD your God Before He causes darkness, And before your feet stumble On the dark mountains, And while you are looking for light, He turns it into the shadow of death [And] makes [it] dense darkness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:17
segments: But if you will not hear it, My soul will weep in secret for [your] pride; My eyes will weep bitterly And run down with tears, Because the LORD'S flock has been taken captive.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:18
segments: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Humble yourselves; Sit down, For your rule shall collapse, the crown of your glory."

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:19
segments: The cities of the South shall be shut up, And no one shall open [them]; Judah shall be carried away captive, all of it; It shall be wholly carried away captive.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:20
segments: Lift up your eyes and see Those who come from the north. Where [is] the flock [that] was given to you, Your beautiful sheep?

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:21
segments: What will you say when He punishes you? For you have taught them [To be] chieftains, to be head over you. Will not pangs seize you, Like a woman in labor?

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:22
segments: ¶And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things come upon me?" For the greatness of your iniquity Your skirts have been uncovered, Your heels made bare.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:23
segments: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard its spots? [Then] may you also do good who are accustomed to do evil.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:24
segments: "Therefore I will scatter them like stubble That passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:25
segments: This is your lot, The portion of your measures from Me," says the LORD, "Because you have forgotten Me And trusted in falsehood.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:26
segments: Therefore I will uncover your skirts over your face, That your shame may appear.

entries.title: Jeremiah 13:27
segments: I have seen your adulteries And your [lustful] neighings, The lewdness of your harlotry, Your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! Will you still not be made clean?"
